task:
Schedule a Pod only on control plane nodes using nodeSelector and tolerations.

Create a Pod named 'pod1' in namespace 'default' with:
  - Image: httpd:2.4-alpine
  - nodeSelector: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: ""
    (this targets nodes with the control-plane role label)
  - Toleration to allow scheduling on the control plane:
      key: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane
      effect: NoSchedule
      operator: Exists

Do NOT add new labels to any nodes — use existing labels only.

Verify the pod lands on the control plane node:
  kubectl get pod pod1 -o wide
  # NODE column should show the control-plane node name
hints: kubectl get nodes --show-labels  to see existing labels on control-plane node
nodeSelector uses existing node labels — do not modify nodes
Toleration key must match the taint key on the control-plane node
Check taints: kubectl describe node <cp-node> | grep Taint
detailed_hints: Control plane nodes typically have label: node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane (value empty string)
YAML: spec.tolerations: [{key: 'node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane', effect: NoSchedule, operator: Exists}]

validators.command: kubectl get pod pod1 -n default -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'
kubectl get pod pod1 -n default -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[0].image}'
kubectl get pod pod1 -n default -o jsonpath='{.spec.nodeSelector}'

validators.description: Pod has a toleration for control-plane taint
validators.command: kubectl get pod pod1 -n default -o jsonpath='{.spec.tolerations[*].key}'
